s: Din mursan bepesach ubo v' seipim: en shorin mursan bemayim [lattarnegolim] mittechillat shaa shishshit vaelak. Apillu im hu omed alehem lirot shello yishheh hammursan lipnehem keshiur mil, vekol pachot mikkashshiur eno ba lide chimmutz — ap al pi ken asur, shehare aseru lehaniach issa belo eseq lekattechilla apillu rega echad, kemo shennitbaer besiman tn"t:

Abal muttar lachlot et hammursan berotechin veachar kak notenan lipne hattarnegolim. Veap al pi sheshshoheh kamma yamim — en bekak kelum, shehechalut eno ba lide chimmutz kelal, abal haggeonim aseru kol chalita, kemo shennitbaer besiman tn"d:

Ukeshehu noten lipnehem seorim o chittim mishshesh vaelak — tzarik lizzaher shello lehashlikam bemaqom lach sheyyukelu labo lide chimmutz. Abal qodem shesh muttar litten lipnehem apillu chametz gamur, raq shetztzarik lizzaher mittechillat lel y"d achar habbediqa vaelak laamod alehem mishsheat akilatam ad sheyyigmeru leekol, kemo shennitbaer besiman tl"g. Umah shemmishtayyer meakilatam lo yannichennu mutal lipnehem, ella yannichennu bemaqom meshummar ad zeman habbiur, kemo shennitbaer sham. Vetob lizzaher mishsheloshim yom qodem happesach vaelak shello lehashlik lipnehem seorim bemaqom lach (ella im ken omed alehem bishat akilatam ad sheyyigmeru leekol, umah shennishtayyer lo yannichennu mutal lipnehem), ki yesh lachosh shemma kesheyyaggia zeman habbediqa lo yaaleh al dato shehammaqom shehishlik sham seorim haya lach velo yibdoq sham, veap im yibdoq sham yimtza seorim shennishtayyeru meakilatam velo yaaleh al dato lebaaram, kevan shekkebar nitnaggebu veen chimmutzan nikkar. Vetob lizzaher shello litten lipnehem mayim lishtot beod shehasseorim munnachin lipnehem, ella yekabbed mittechilla oto maqom heteb veachar kak yitten sham mayim:

Lo tashreh haishsha et hammursan bemayim mishshesh vaelak lashup bo et besarah bammerchatz. Abal mutteret lashup al besarah mursan yabesh apillu beod shemme hazzea topechin al besarah, lepi shezzeat haadam eno kemayim lehabi lide chimmutz im eno mazzia mechamat chom hammayim ella mechamat chom haur, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ts"v. Umikkol maqom, tzerika hi lizzaher lehaabir kol hammursan meal kol besarah qodem shettirchatz gupah bemayim ben bechammim ben betzonenin. Ulepi sheakshav en hannashim beqiot bekak, lepikak asur lahem lashup mursan al besaran apillu hu yabesh:

Im shipshepu mursan beavvaz lach mimmayim ap al pi shehu tzonen, ben beodo beoro ben keshehupshat meoro — asur leoklo bepesach, mippene shehammursan niknas banneqabim sheyyesh beoro, vegam babbasar yesh beqaim bekol tzad, vederek hanneqabim vehabbeqaim nibla taam hammursan baavvaz. Veap al pi shebbishar issurim, kegon basar tzonen shennapal letok chalab tzonen, ap al pi sheyyesh babbasar beqaim harbeh nohagin lehattir habbasar al yede shetipa vahadacha behepsed merubbeh o sheat haddechaq kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman tz"a, mikkol maqom leinyan chametz bepesach sheoser apillu bemashshehu — yesh lehachamir veleesor baakila. Abal im shipshepo qodem happesach, apillu beereb pesach achar shaa shishshit vaelak — yesh lehattir bimqom hepsed merubbeh o sheat haddechaq ap leoklo betok happesach, ubilbad sheyyizzaher lehadicho uleshapshepo bemayim yapeh betok happesach:

Yesh lizzaher lekattechilla shello yehabhebu haopot bepesach beqashshin, dehaynu zanbot hashshibbolim, ki shemma yesh gargir dagan chametz betok hashshibbolin veyitten taam baopot bishat hahibhub. Umikkol maqom, bediabad en leesor haopot. Vaapillu im matza harbeh gargerim hamchummatzim bashshibbolim hannotarim leachar hahibhub — en machaziqin issur missapeq lomar sheggam bashshibbolim shehibheb bahem haya bahem gargerim mechummatzim, ella tolin lomar shekkol haggargerim napelu mehem bishat haddisha. (Abal im yadua lanu shehaya gargir mechummatz bashshibbolim shehibheb bahem — yesh leesor haopot baakila, shechametz bepesach bemashshehu). Veken im nimtza shibbolet reqanit betabshil nimmoach — en chosheshin shemma haya dagan mechummatz bashshibbolet venapal letok hattabshil venimmoach sham:
